title: Sequential Testing on Complex and High Dimensional Data Streams Leveraging Unsupervised Model Errors
abstract: arXiv:2611.33238v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose two general, distribution-free test statistics for binary Sequential Hypothesis Testing (SHT) and Sequential Change Point Detection (SCPD) respectively, in streaming environments where the data (e.g., network traffic metadata) are too complicated for the exact probabilistic modeling required by conventional likelihood ratio-driven tests. Our framework also addresses the challenge of information asymmetry, where data is available only from the null/pre-change regime and not from the alternative/post-change one such as zero-day attacks or emerging disease related regimes. The proposed statistics monitor the errors of a predictive or reconstructive machine learning model trained solely on null/pre-change data, relying on imperfect generalization (the model's performance will degrade when deployed on data from the alternative/post-change class). translated_title: 基于无监督模型误差的复杂高维数据流序贯检验
translated_abstract: 我们提出了两个通用的、无分布假设的检验统计量，分别用于二元序贯假设检验（SHT）和序贯变点检测（SCPD），适用于流式环境中数据（如网络流量元数据）过于复杂、无法进行传统似然比驱动检验所要求的精确概率建模的场景。我们的框架还解决了信息不对称的挑战，即数据仅来自零假设/变化前状态，而无法获得来自备择假设/变化后状态的数据，例如零日攻击或新兴疾病相关状态。所提出的统计量通过监测仅在零假设/变化前数据上训练的预测或重构机器学习模型的误差来工作，依赖于模型不完美的泛化能力（当模型部署于来自备择假设/变化后类别的数据时，其性能会下降）。在对模型误差的温和假设条件下，我们建立了严格的分析保证……
tldr: 该论文提出利用仅在正常数据上训练的无监督模型误差作为检验统计量，为复杂高维数据流设计了无需分布假设的序贯假设检验与变点检测方法，解决了仅有变化前数据的信息不对称难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two distribution-free test statistics that leverage errors from unsupervised models trained solely on null/pre-change data, enabling sequential hypothesis testing and change point detection on complex high-dimensional data streams while addressing the information asymmetry challenge.
